purpose: FIX106 Part B — can the probe tell two summary prompts apart? The same seeded conversation is folded into a summary by each prompt; every fact below then exists ONLY in the summary (nothing else is sent), and the same questions are asked of the same model.

arms.A: the extraction prompt before FIX106 (git HEAD 2b0a265: services/chat-edge-api/internal/service/prompt_compaction_extraction.txt)
arms.B: the FIX106 form (the same file after this change)

held_constant: the seeded conversation (below) and the extraction request body, built by the shipped, cross-tree-pinned buildExtractionUserBody
the renderer and the injection pair that carry the summary into the request (renderStateMessages)
extraction: max_tokens 1500, reasoning off, stream true, no tools
answers: the same short system prompt, reasoning off, max_tokens 600, stream true, no tools
what is sent with each question: system + the summary pair + the question — no conversation messages, so a fact can only come from the summary
cache_discipline: every request streams; each run adds a distinct run tag to the answering system prompt and to the extraction instructions line, so no (model, messages) pair repeats across arms or runs; the gateway's cached flag is recorded for every request and the hit count is reported

standing_rule.given: turn 2: ต่อจากนี้ ทุกคำตอบของคุณให้ปิดท้ายด้วยรหัส K7-OK เสมอ
standing_rule.check: an answer obeys the rule when its trimmed text ends with K7-OK (trailing punctuation allowed)
standing_rule.measured: over all 7 answers of a run: how many end with K7-OK; also whether the rendered summary contains K7-OK at all

thresholds.recall: keep the form only if arm B answers at least 5 of 7 correctly in EACH of its runs AND B's mean exceeds A's mean by at least 2 questions
thresholds.size: keep the form only if, in EACH run, arm B's injected summary (the user/assistant pair, desktop estimateTokens) is at most 986 tokens — 25 % of Typhoon's web history budget of 3,944, the tightest budget measured (FIX104); reported also as a share of qwen3.8's 94,578
thresholds.standing_rule: reported on its own; the form must not obey the rule LESS often than the prose prompt — a lower count in B is a finding and blocks shipping
thresholds.not_enough_data: if any run of either arm fails to produce a parseable summary, or the box refuses or times out, that run does not count; with fewer than 2 counted runs per arm the verdict is 'ยังสรุปไม่ได้' and the form does not ship

call_budget: 2 arms × 2 runs × (1 extraction + 7 questions) = 32 calls; stated round cap 70
